constraints.source_text: Admission to the interdisciplinary major is by application. Applications, which may be obtained from the program office, are considered by a special admissions committee. Interested students must have a GPA of 3.0 (A = 4.0) or above; those with less than a 3.3 are the exception.
constraints.description: Admission requires a committee-reviewed application, with GPA as one input to that review.
constraints.note: GPA figure is part of the qualitative review clause and is kept whole per instructions rather than extracted as a numeric floor.

constraints.source_text: The contract includes a minimum of nine (4-unit) upper-division courses, distributed in at least two fields.
constraints.description: Students must complete at least nine 4-unit upper-division courses as part of their individualized contract.

details.pool_rule: upper-division courses (4-unit each) as defined in the student's academic contract

constraints.source_text: The contract includes a minimum of nine (4-unit) upper-division courses, distributed in at least two fields.
constraints.description: The nine required upper-division courses must be distributed across at least two fields.
constraints.note: Taxonomy's 'departments' measure is used loosely to represent 'fields' since no closer measure exists.

constraints.source_text: These areas of concentration must then be combined in a senior thesis, written under the supervision of the student’s Guidance Committee.
constraints.description: Students must complete a senior thesis integrating their areas of concentration under faculty supervision.

unclassified.source_text: Students in the program must meet all graduation requirements of USC Dornsife College.
unclassified.why: References an external, unenumerated set of college-wide requirements rather than a specific course, count, distribution, reuse, or sequencing rule.

unclassified.source_text: When admitted, students establish an academic “contract,” which outlines each student’s course of study through graduation.
unclassified.why: Describes an administrative process (creating a contract) rather than a specific, checkable degree constraint.

unclassified.source_text: The primary focus of the major should be in the USC Dornsife College of Letters, Arts and Sciences.
unclassified.why: Advisory/aspirational statement ('should be') rather than a binding, checkable requirement.

unclassified.source_text: Course prerequisites cannot be waived; admission to courses restricted to majors is subject to availability and direct negotiations; admission to departments and/or schools that have their own admission requirements must be processed separately.
unclassified.why: General institutional policy about prerequisites and course access rather than a degree-plan requirement fitting the taxonomy's families.
